_readme: Strings of the CRSM menus (the Manager tab of the Training pause menu and the On/Off toggles of its native option dialogs). Loaded by autorun/crsm/NativeLocale.lua from data/SF6_CRSM_data/locale.json; the language follows the GAME's text language (via.Language). Missing key or language -> English. %s / %d are format slots, <ICON ...> / <color ...> tags are the game's own markup.
